textRuns.value: Bounds are written onto each result row when it is measured, never looked up when it is read, so widening a bound later cannot reinterpret a result recorded under the old one. Bound versions above 1 for any rule means a bound moved, and the lower and upper shown become the outermost band rather than the band in force. Freshness carries no verdict: no bound is set for any of the six sources, so the lag is recorded and asserted against nothing.
